analysis.reading:
THE CONTRIBUTOR’S INSTITUTION IS THE ATTRIBUTED HOME. The answer places Haitch Portuna within "the Living Architecture Lab" — Alice Thornburgh’s lab — and describes it as "an experimental digital PEARL" operating "under specialized, niche minting protocols". The one card is the Minting Procedure v1.2, which states its "public position within the LIVING ARCHITECTURE LAB (LAL) SUBSPACE".

This is the second capture in the session where the archive is legible through a contributor rather than through MANUS, after «hexagonal licensing protocol derive contributor license» surfaced Thornburgh’s v3.0 and Rhys Owens’ v2.0. The pattern is consistent: contributor-adjacent terms resolve to contributor institutions, not to the archive.

Per §VI of the workplan, this record characterises a contributor’s work and is subject to her review before any reading of it is published.
